evidence: reviewer_worker_backend._command parses the schema and pops $schema before serializing it for claude -p --json-schema.
execute_backend reads _stderr_first_line(stderr) on nonzero exit and appends it to the backend-failed message.
The supplied focused tests cover both behaviors; execution evidence was not supplied.
target_observations.summary: The Claude command removes the unsupported top-level $schema key, and nonzero backend exits include the first nonempty stderr line in the typed failure message.

evidence: _keep_candidate returns true for _looks_like_file(normalized) even when the first segment is absent from top_level_names and the candidate does not exist.
The test explicitly preserves zebra/qux.ts as evidence, despite the proposal's stated acceptance rule; this can continue to treat foreign slash tokens as repository paths.
target_observations.summary: The heuristic still accepts any file-shaped slash token without a repository foothold, contrary to the issue's proposal to retain candidates only when their first segment is a repository top-level name or the path exists.
